source: FIGURES.md adapted for clubs, 2026-09-24, as for the Paris, Barcelona and Amsterdam guides. S4 consensus: Time Out '12 best clubs in NYC' (read in full), VileVeil 'Best techno clubs in New York City' (headings), Gothamist on Basement (2023). S5 history: Wikipedia The Loft, Paradise Garage, Studio 54, Danceteria, Limelight, Tunnel, Twilo, New York City Cabaret Law, Avant Gardner; Pitchfork on Output; DJ Mag on Nowadays. Reddit r/avesNYC is blocked in both browsers and to curl; read through Google result snippets on 2026-09-24 (site:reddit.com avesNYC). Clubs named by 2+ current sources: Basement, Public Records, Good Room, Nowadays, Elsewhere. Paragon and Signal (clubs) and Soul Summit and 718 Sessions (house parties), first seen in r/avesNYC snippets, were added on 2026-09-24 at the owner's request after confirming each in a second source: DJ Mag (Paragon reopening, 16 July 2025), Resident Advisor, DJ Mag and Greenpointers (Signal, May and June 2025), the Fort Greene Park Conservancy (Soul Summit) and dannykrivit.net plus Resident Advisor (718 Sessions).
